Anderson .Paak has 22.8M monthly listeners on Spotify. Cordae has 5.5M. Their joint album Heavy Is The Crown is out Oct 23. 👑

The duo announced the album in August 2026 (via APESHIT / Mass Appeal / EMPIRE, release date per albumoftheyear.org and retailer listings). The link goes back to Cordae's 2019 debut The Lost Boy, where .Paak featured on "RNP", which is now Cordae's biggest song with 265.5M Spotify streams (kworb, Oct 15, 2026).

The gap is real but it's mostly features. .Paak has 9.7B total Spotify streams across 264 tracks, led by Silk Sonic's "Leave The Door Open" (1.85B), "Smokin Out The Window" (651.8M) and Mac Miller's "Dang!" (489.5M). Cordae has 2.4B across 88 tracks. As a lead artist it's 2.50B vs 1.66B, only 1.5x. As a featured artist: 7.2B vs 0.8B.

Who do you think carries the album, the hit-maker or the rapper? 👇

Data: Spotify monthly listeners + kworb Spotify stream totals · as of Oct 15, 2026 · release date via albumoftheyear.org
